# GitHub Workflows (`.github/workflows`)

This directory contains GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow pipeline definitions for VisionOS.

## Planned Workflows

- **`ci.yml`**: Monorepo linting, type-checking, and unit test execution across apps, services, and packages.
- **`docker-build.yml`**: Multi-arch Docker container image builds (x86_64, arm64) for microservices and edge nodes.
- **`release.yml`**: Automated semantic versioning and release tag generation.
